# NutriFit

> All-in-one health & fitness platform: workouts, nutrition, recipes, community and an AI coach.

NutriFit helps users achieve health goals with guided workouts, macro tracking, healthy recipes, local fitness communities, and a personalized AI fitness coach. Premium subscription is R49/month.
